title: ALX Core Test Vector Suite
description: Structural envelope for core conformance vector files under protocol/test-vectors/. Individual vector payloads vary by suite.

helpers.description: Human-readable notation aids for readers parsing the vector file. Not used by runners.

note.description: Explanatory text for vectors where the input cannot be represented in JSON or requires special handling. Does not affect runner logic.

inputShape.description: Discriminator for multi-input vectors. 'single' = use 'input'; 'pair' = use 'input_a' and 'input_b'. Absent when the vector uses a different field (e.g. 'graph').

operation.description: SDK function name the runner must call for this vector.

input.description: Single input value. Present when inputShape is 'single' or when the suite has a fixed input field.

input_a.description: First of a pair of inputs. Present when inputShape is 'pair'.

input_b.description: Second of a pair of inputs. Present when inputShape is 'pair'.

graph.description: Graph input for trace and lineage vectors: maps blockHash strings to arrays of parent blockHash strings.

assertions.description: Human-readable assertion expressions describing the expected relationship between inputs and outputs.

context.description: Optional verification context passed to traceAttribution or validateGraph. Used for open-world vectors.

expected.description: Expected output or outcome. Shape varies by suite.
